fetch_historical_prices: fetch historical daily price data for a stock ticker between two dates
fetch_financial_metrics: fetch financial metrics for a stock ticker with a report period end date and limit
fetch_company_news: fetch paginated company news articles for a stock ticker within a date range
fetch_insider_trades: fetch paginated insider trades for a stock ticker within a filing date range
fetch_market_cap: fetch the market cap for a stock ticker on a given end date
